fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: A closing blow that deals 24 damage, sets the target [Burning] for 5 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Beating the Brush
fusions.desc: Sweeps a low cone of flame that deals 4 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you. Each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Ashen Kite
fusions.desc: Looses a bird of cinders for 12 seconds. Every 1.2 seconds it strikes an enemy within 6 tiles and deals 4 damage, with a 30% chance to set it [Burning] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Scorched Quarry
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage. You have 8% fire resistance.
